author: jessica
source: home-office office/projects/delves/backlog.md, new candidates: retrieve under fire (carry it out while they come)
_note: EXTRACTION, a new type, written 2026-10-12 on his "First we need 01a and 02a" and his pick of the
Shape: pick up the case, the site wakes and three waves come (09a's hold, with its wave plumbing unchanged),
then carry the case out to the crew's beacon. 09a is pickup, deliver, hold; this is pickup, hold, deliver,
so the thing you defend is in your pack and the walk out is the last beat.
No message boxes: this is an action type (his 2026-10-08 ruling for holds). The turn is told by the hold's
say line, so it is heard in play rather than read in the journal.
The pickup carries no journal on purpose: the hold's stage is set the same instant and the log shows only the
Wave sizes and styles copy 09a, which are ELIZA'S PLACEHOLDER escalation. The words are Jessica's.
MODEL NOT ON THE APPROVED LIST, his eye first: Satellite_Beacon.nif (vanilla's Satellite_Beacon static) as the
crew's drop beacon. The sample case is the approved freight crate.
Pay: a combat job, and a tier above 07a's would suit it; whether a single-ending beats Delve can set its own tier
is Eliza's open question (type 8's page), so it pays the base's stage 100 for now.

place._theme: No natural or cave sites: his 09a ruling 2026-10-12 once waves spawn close behind the player, and the base's own exclusions.

prose.name: Recovery: Core Samples on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A mining crew was run off the <Place> and had to leave a case of core samples behind. They want it back, and whoever ran them off may not have gone far.

say: They're coming back for it. Hang on to that case.
beats._say: Moved here from the hold beat 2026-10-12 (Eliza): a beat's say plays when its stage is SET, and the hold's is set when the third wave dies, so the warning would have come after the danger. Beat 1's stage is where wave 1 spawns, as 09a's "Keep an eye out" sits on the beat before its hold. Words unchanged.
beats.objective: Recover the core sample case at the <Place>
beats.name: Abandoned Sample Case

beats.journal: As soon as I lifted the sample case, the people who ran the crew off came back for it. I have to deal with them before I can get it out.

beats.objective: Take the samples to the drop beacon
beats.journal: I got the crew's core samples out of the <Place> under fire and left them at their drop beacon for pickup.
beats.name: Crew Drop Beacon
say: That's a whole season's work in that case, and it's safe now.

broadcast: We got run off and left our samples behind, and we can't go back in for them with those things still out there. Watch yourself, because they didn't go far.
_speech: Radio rules: no names, no places. Voice is ElevenLabs' 'Chris, Charming, Down-to-Earth', NOT yet heard in game (voices.md); his ear decides.
